prompt: Create a vertical 4:5 editorial poster combining outdoor lifestyle photography with bold hand-painted typography. Show a young woman relaxing in a lush green meadow at dusk, lying diagonally across tall grass with both arms folded behind her head, looking calmly upward and slightly away from camera. She has long dark hair, a natural contemplative expression, and wears a blue baseball cap, an oversized blue-and-white striped button-up shirt, a white ribbed tank top, and blue jeans. Use warm late-afternoon sunlight, deep green grass texture, a tree-lined background fading into soft focus, candid film-photography grain, high contrast, and a relaxed summer mood. Overlay large rough white brush-lettering across the image: top text reads “SPEAK LOUD AND THE WORLD ECHOES BACK”; bottom text reads “FIND LITTLE FIRES OF LIFE IN THE DUSK”. Add exactly 1 small white doodle icon near the center-right between the text blocks: a hand-drawn smiley face with three wavy motion lines. Typography should be all caps, irregular, thick, energetic, slightly distressed, and integrated over the grass and subject without looking digitally perfect. Keep the subject visible beneath the text, with the upper quote occupying the top half and the lower quote occupying the lower third. No borders, no watermark, no extra logos, no additional text.

promptZh: 创作一张 4:5 的竖版编辑海报，将户外生活方式摄影与醒目的手绘排版相结合。画面展示了一位年轻女性在黄昏时分郁郁葱葱的草地上放松，斜躺在长草丛中，双臂交叉枕在脑后，神情平静地向上方望去，视线略微偏离镜头。她留着深色长发，表情自然且若有所思，戴着蓝色棒球帽，身穿超大号蓝白条纹衬衫、白色罗纹背心和蓝色牛仔裤。运用温暖的午后阳光、深绿色的草地纹理、背景中虚化的树林，呈现出胶片摄影的颗粒感、高对比度以及轻松的夏季氛围。在图像上叠加粗犷的白色大号手写字体：顶部文字为“SPEAK LOUD AND THE WORLD ECHOES BACK”；底部文字为“FIND LITTLE FIRES OF LIFE IN THE DUSK”。在文本块之间的中右侧添加 1 个白色小涂鸦图标：一个带有三条波浪形动感线条的手绘笑脸。字体应为全大写、不规则、粗体、充满活力且略带磨损感，并与草地和人物主体融合，避免过于数字化。保持主体在文字下方可见，顶部语录占据上半部分，底部语录占据下三分之一。无边框，无水印，无额外 Logo，无其他文字。
